title: The Conflict Between Explainable and Accountable Decision-Making Algorithms
reasoning: The paper evaluates the ethics of Explainable AI (XAI) and its impact on moral responsibility. It uses philosophical frameworks (e.g., Scanlon's theory of blame and Shoemaker's notions of moral responsibility) to critique how post-hoc explanations can obscure human accountability and create 'moral scapegoats'.
